item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 29/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A weak northeast monsoon will reach southern China today and there will be more showers over the region. Tropical Cyclone Saola will move in the general direction of the southern part of Taiwan to the Luzon Strait in the next couple of days, and edge closer to the vicinity of the coast of southern Fujian to eastern Guangdong afterwards. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Haikui located to the east of Saola will move in the general direction of the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands in the next couple of days. It may interact with Saola and there are large uncertainties in the subsequent movement of Saola. The outer subsiding air of Saola will bring very hot weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. Under the influence of Saola, it will be windier with a few showers over the coast of eastern Guangdong towards the weekend.
